headline: USA and Japan Have Carried Out Currency Intervention
summary: The US and Japan confirmed they carried out a joint currency intervention last week to stop the yen's fall after it weakened to its lowest level.
why: Coordinated intervention by the US Treasury and Japan's Ministry of Finance is a rare, direct move in the currency market. It affects yen-dollar pricing, which matters for carry trades, Japanese exporters and global bond yields.
why_moved: The yen had weakened to its lowest level, and the US and Japan jointly intervened last week to halt that fall.
